other_whatsahonda_observations.cross_branch: Several nonmilitary columns visibly share these count families but titles differ. No wholesale Imperial Republic mapping inferred.
other_whatsahonda_observations.grand_ranks: Large outer gold squares at Grand General and Grand Admiral are distinct appointment-like devices, not counted as cylinders.

taivaansusi_rank_table.cylinders: No side-cylinder marks depicted anywhere in inspected chart; colored rank tiles and bars only. Cannot supply rank-to-cylinder rules.

taivaansusi_uniform_observations.external_institution: Imperial Intelligence Service, Directorate of Active Measures (ACME)
taivaansusi_uniform_observations.note: Frontal wearer; plaque on viewer-right/wearer-left chest. One cylinder opposite plaque and two by plaque.
Viewer-left crop edge and cloak obscure complete count; do not invent opposite-pocket count.

mapping_policy: Keep title-aligned proposals distinct from observed external counts. No source inspected here establishes Imperial Republic grade/class cylinder entitlement. Preserve unknown vs zero; flag any bridging/interpolation separately.
